title: mentha pulegium var. vulgaris
intro: Mentha pulegium var. vulgaris, commonly known as American Pennyroyal, is a perennial herb native to North America, characterized by its small, oval-shaped leaves and tiny blue or purple flowers. American Pennyroyal has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as relieving digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and acting as a natural antiseptic. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and improve respiratory function. The bioactive constituents of American Pennyroyal include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in herbal remedies.
